tier1.headline: Your data is shared broadly.
tier1.quote: We may share Personal Data with the following recipients: Abuse and Fraud Prevention Entities, Affiliates, GitHub Organization Accounts, Competent Authorities, Corporate Transaction Entities, Partners and Resellers, Subprocessors and Service Providers, Other Third-party Applications, Other Users and the Public.

tier1.headline: Your data trains AI models.
tier1.quote: Personal Data is collected from you directly, automatically from your device, and also from third parties. The Personal Data GitHub processes when you use the Services depends on variables like how you interact with our Services (such as through web interfaces, desktop or mobile applications), the features you use (such as pull requests, Codespaces, or GitHub Copilot) and your method of accessing the Services (your preferred IDE).

tier1.headline: Your data is collected without consent.
tier1.quote: We may acquire information about you from publicly available sources like public GitHub repositories.

tier2.headline: Your DNT signal is disregarded.
tier2.quote: If your browser sends a Do Not Track (DNT) signal, GitHub will not set non-essential cookies and will not load third party resources which set non-essential cookies.

tier2.headline: Your data is shared with affiliates.
tier2.quote: Personal Data may be shared with GitHub affiliates, including Microsoft, to facilitate customer service, marketing and advertising, order fulfillment, billing, technical support, and legal and compliance obligations.

tier2.headline: Your data retained indefinitely for ML.
tier2.quote: We’ll retain your Personal Data as long as your account is active and as needed to fulfill contractual obligations, comply with legal requirements, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements.

tier2.headline: Your precise location is collected.
tier2.quote: Depending on the Service's functionality, we collect regional geolocation data.

tier2.headline: Your behavior is used to infer traits.
tier2.quote: We generate new information from other data we collect to derive likely preferences or other characteristics.

tier2.headline: Your data used for targeted ads.
tier2.quote: Our analytics and advertising partners may use these technologies in our Services to collect personal information (such as the pages you visit, the links you click on, and similar usage information, identifiers, and device information) related to your online activities over time and across Services for various purposes, including targeted advertising.

tier2.headline: Your data is transferred internationally.
tier2.quote: We transfer Personal Data from the European Union, the United Kingdom, and Switzerland to countries that the European Commission has not recognized as having an adequate level of data protection.

tier2.headline: Your data shared without warrant.
tier2.quote: We may disclose Personal Data to authorized law enforcement, regulators, courts, or other public authorities in response to lawful requests or to protect our rights and safety.
